newsitem.title: ITALY: Saes Getters posts lower 1996 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Saes Getters posts lower 1996 net profit.

text.p: Italian electronic components maker Saes Getters SpA said its 1996 group net profit fell to 17.7 billion lire from 26.9 billion in 1995, due mainly to the negative effect of the lira's appreciation.
The company said, which is also listed on Nasdaq, said it proposed paying an unchanged dividend of 300 lire per ordinary share, 320 lire per preference share and 330 lire per savings share.
Consolidated turnover rose 5.4 percent to 181.8 billion lire.
The company, a world leader in vacuum technology, was listed on Nasdaq in May 1996.
